flows.title: Breathe — Onboarding Intro
flows.description: Interactive breathing dot-field that opens the AI questionnaire. The red ball morphs through four health-need states — Weight, Muscle, Pregnancy, Gut — auto-progressing and tappable via the segmented control.

handoff.State input: ViewModel “Machine” · number “state”: 0 ball · 1 weight · 2 muscle · 3 pregnancy · 4 gut
handoff.Caption output: number “shown”: 0 hidden · 1–4 feature caption · 5 intro blurb
handoff.Layout: 402pt design width · animation stage 450×554pt, ball center at 39% of stage height · header pinned to safe-area top, actions pinned above home bar
handoff.Type: Urbane Rounded Medium/DemiBold · Proxima Nova Regular (files in this folder)
handoff.Brand rule: Ball dots are red #FF3848 on #ED1C24; icons+headlines resolve to white. Never recolor.
handoff.Nav buttons: Liquid Glass (iOS 26) rendered in CSS: backdrop-filter blur(9px) saturate(175%) + specular inset rim; native SwiftUI equivalent = .glassEffect()
